summary: Brimyr is a patch-coverage gate. It detects a repo's ecosystem (Python / JS-TS / .NET), runs that ecosystem's test command with coverage on, and gates a PR only on the coverage of the lines the diff added — pre-existing uncovered code never blocks. A pure, stdlib-only core under src/brimyr/coverage/ does the arithmetic (diff parsing, report parsing, intersection); thin side-effecting edges (git.py, runner.py, sonar.py) shell out and inject their runners. One `brimyr` CLI backs three surfaces: a composite action, a reusable workflow, and a pre-commit pre-push hook.

cli.purpose: argparse dispatch (coverage | ci | local | version) plus _run_flow — the single pipeline every surface executes: collect coverage -> compute the diff -> patch coverage -> gate -> summary/outputs.

coverage.diff.purpose: Pure unified-diff parser: diff text -> DiffIndex of changed files and added line ranges. Also owns path normalisation (a/ b/ prefix stripping, separators), used repo-wide.

coverage.model.purpose: Coverage data model. CoverageBuilder accumulates per-line hit counts with max-wins semantics (covered by any test => covered); merge_reports folds multi-ecosystem runs into one report.

coverage.lcov.purpose: lcov .info text -> CoverageReport. Hand-rolled DA-record parser, no third-party dependency.

coverage.cobertura.purpose: Cobertura XML -> CoverageReport via xml.etree; raises CoberturaError on malformed input so the caller can mark the run broken.

coverage.patch.purpose: THE GATE'S HEART. Intersects a DiffIndex with a CoverageReport: added lines AND executable lines -> covered/missing per file, plus the overall percentage. Path matching goes exact -> prefix-stripped -> suffix in either direction (PatchPolicy).

git.purpose: The ONLY git/subprocess boundary for history: merge-base resolution, diff text, shallow-clone detection. compute_changed_lines returns a ready DiffIndex.

detect.purpose: The ECOSYSTEMS table: marker files -> Ecosystem (test command, coverage format, expected report path, Sonar property). JS/TS additionally requires a test signal in package.json before it counts. locate_coverage_file globs the emitted report.

runner.purpose: Runs each detected ecosystem's tests with coverage, locates and ingests the report. Encodes the broken-run rule: a launch failure, a missing report, or an unparseable one becomes RunOutcome.error and RunResult.broken — never a 0% score. Injectable Runner for tests.

sonar.purpose: Builds sonar-scanner -D arguments from a SonarConfig and runs it, failure-isolated: it never raises and never changes the gate verdict, it only returns a SonarResult message for the summary.

gate.purpose: Turns a PatchCoverage plus a threshold into a GateDecision and the process exit code. Handles broken runs (exit 2), report-only baseline mode, and the vacuous pass when nothing coverable changed.

modes.purpose: Mode.PR (gates) vs Mode.BASELINE (report-only), resolved from an explicit --mode or GITHUB_EVENT_NAME. Mode.gates is the single switch the flow reads.

report.purpose: Renders the Markdown job summary (verdict, percentage, per-file misses, ecosystems, Sonar note) and writes GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY / GITHUB_OUTPUT. No-ops cleanly off CI.

local.purpose: Infers the base ref for the pre-push hook (explicit -> upstream -> origin/HEAD -> default branch), returning None when it cannot, so the CLI can ask for --base.

surface.action.purpose: Composite GitHub Action wrapping `brimyr ci`: inputs mirror the CLI flags (mode, threshold, ecosystem, sonar-*), outputs mirror the gate outputs.

surface.workflow.purpose: Reusable workflow (workflow_call) that checks out with enough history, sets up the toolchain, fetches the action, and runs it — the drop-in way for consumer repos.

surface.hook.purpose: pre-commit hook id `brimyr` running `brimyr local` at the pre-push stage (too heavy for pre-commit: it runs the whole suite).

tests.purpose: One test module per source module (tests/test_<module>.py), plus conftest.py fixtures. Core modules are tested on literal diff/report text; edge modules inject a fake runner so no real toolchain is needed.

callgraph_highlights.note: Pure dispatch. Every command except `version` funnels into _run_flow.
The whole product in ~40 lines — read this before anything else. Baseline mode and broken runs skip the diff and gate on an empty DiffIndex.
--coverage-file is an escape hatch that ingests pre-made reports and never runs tests; otherwise ecosystems are detected (or forced) and run.
Every failure path here produces RunOutcome.error -> RunResult.broken -> exit 2, never a 0% gate failure.
Denominator = added lines AND FileCoverage.executable. Deleted files are skipped; files the report never mentions contribute nothing (diff-cover behaviour).
Shallow clones raise ShallowCloneError, which the CLI turns into exit 2 with a fetch-depth hint.
Max-hits-wins is why merging several ecosystems (or several test runs) can only ever mark more lines covered.
